# Aphrody

Private Rust/Bun monorepo: the Bun fork runtime (`yolo`), the Python runtime (`vu`), the `aphrody` CLI/MCP/FFI and the M3 UI framework.

Totals: 219 crates, 98 packages, 6 apps.

| Path | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `apps/<domain>/<app>` | Applications |
| `packages/<domain>/<package>` | Bun packages |
| `crates/<domain>/<crate>` | Rust crates |
| `m3/` | UI framework, `m3/packages/app-ui` |
| `py/` | Python packages |
| `config/` | Build, product, host and deployment declarations |
| `scripts/` | audit, build, dev, migration, release, tools |
| `docs/` | Guides, contracts, generated references |
| `.coord/` | Claims and receipts |

- [PLAN.md](PLAN.md): Architecture, contracts, open queue
- [MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md): Dated evidence and limits
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Working rules
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): Documentation index
- [docs/reference/workspace/STATE.md](docs/reference/workspace/STATE.md): Workspace inventory
